### Statistical & Ensemble Modeling for High-Dimensional Regression
**STAT 452 — Statistical Learning and Prediction** *(Fall 2026)*

<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
  <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" href="assets/course_stat452_project_report_eric_cheung.pdf" target="_blank" role="button">Project Report (PDF)</a>
</div>

- Built an end-to-end predictive modeling pipeline in R on a 156,348-row continuous-response dataset, systematically evaluating eight statistical and machine learning model families via 5-fold cross-validation.
- Performed permutation variable importance screening using Random Forests (`ranger`) to identify primary signal drivers and construct interaction-augmented linear models.
- Progressed from regularized linear baselines (OLS, LASSO) and Generalized Additive Models (`mgcv::bam`) to non-parametric tree ensembles, capturing complex non-linear predictor interactions.
- Engineered a multi-architecture `xgboost` ensemble that reduced 5-fold cross-validation MSPE by 99.91% from the sample-mean baseline ($1.100 \times 10^{12}$ to $9.943 \times 10^8$, and $9.752 \times 10^8$ on held-out validation).

**Key Technologies:** R, `xgboost`, `ranger`, `mgcv`, `glmnet`, `tidyverse`, 5-Fold Cross-Validation, Ensemble Learning.

### Unsupervised Pangenomic Analysis of *Paenibacillus polymyxa*
**CMPT 353 — Computational Data Science** *(Summer 2026)*

<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
  <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="https://github.com/eric1162004/CMPT353_P_POLYMYXA_PANGENOME_PIPELINE" target="_blank" role="button">GitHub Repository</a>
  <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" href="assets/course_cmpt353_pangenomic_analysis_eric_cheung.pdf" target="_blank" role="button">Project Report (PDF)</a>
</div>

- Developed an unsupervised machine learning pipeline in Python to analyze 62 *P. polymyxa* draft genomes, resolving species boundaries and evolutionary sub-lineages.
- Engineered a custom GFF3 parsing module using Pandas to filter biological noise and extract Coding Sequences (CDS), constructing a $62 \times 4,460$ binary presence/absence feature matrix.
- Mapped global genomic variance via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and evaluated population structures using K-Means and Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering (HCA) with Jaccard distance.
- Extracted top genetic loading drivers across PC1 and PC2, and implemented targeted regex keyword profiling to compute a normalized Target Functional Index for pathogenic risk screening.

**Key Technologies:** Python, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PCA, HCA, K-Means, Regular Expressions, Matplotlib.

### Reliable Data Transfer Protocol over UDP
**CMPT 371 — Data Communications and Networking** *(Fall 2025)*

<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem; display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
  <a class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" href="https://github.com/eric1162004/CMPT371-MINI-PROJECT-2-RELIABLE-DATA-TRANSFER" target="_blank" role="button">GitHub Repository</a>
  <a class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm" href="assets/course_cmpt371_rdt_report_eric_cheung.pdf" target="_blank" role="button">Project Report (PDF)</a>
</div>

- Implemented a pipelined Reliable Data Transfer (RDT) transport protocol over UDP featuring cumulative ACKs and fast retransmit, achieving 100% in-order delivery across network conditions with packet loss, delay, duplication, and bit-error corruption.
- Engineered TCP-style sliding window congestion control alongside receiver-advertised flow control to dynamically adapt cwnd and rwnd behavior during low-consume conditions.
- Validated protocol invariants with a suite confirming handshake integrity, retransmission timeouts, and buffer allocation.

**Key Technologies:** Python, UDP Sockets, Network Simulation, Protocol Verification, Flow & Congestion Control.
